independent_checks.colored_ring_mapping: For each matching edge pair {x_i,y_i}, quotienting by (x_i,y_i)^2 leaves monomials using zero or one endpoint per pair. Degree-k monomials therefore correspond bijectively to rank-k independent sets of the matching, and multiplication/deletion gives the ordinary face-poset shadow.
independent_checks.shadow_theorem_scope: Chong arXiv:1403.3158v2 Theorem 1.2(i) gives the Macaulay-Lex result for colored quotient rings of type (1,...,1); Theorem 2.1(iii) and its stated shadow consequence apply to the revlex lower shadow in that setting. This supports the unweighted matching-sector shadow assertion, not a distinguished-tag or extra insertion statistic.
independent_checks.normalized_matching_scope: West-Harper-Daykin, JCTA 35 (1983), pp. 302-303, gives the product theorem for LYM/normalized matching posets under log-concavity of rank sizes. The matching sector is the product of n factors with ranks of sizes (1,2); its ordinary adjacent-rank cover flow is unweighted and has no hub-insertion or selected-tag edge constraints.

toy_graph_reconstruction.calculation: For {b}, a is blocked by ab and h is not adjacent to b, so h is the sole addable vertex. For {a}, both b and h are blocked. In both cases deleting the sole rank-one set gives the same lower shadow {empty set}.
toy_graph_reconstruction.scope: Exact auxiliary-graph counterexample to preservation of this extra addability statistic under the specified compression; not a tree counterexample, CB instance, or mixed-boundary inequality refutation.

independent_checks.target_and_standing_controls: The source route explicitly disclaims a complete CB edge encoding, full selector audit, and primary aggregate result. The example makes no claim about x(T), eligibility, original leaves/supports, selector F, or a complete sum S(T,p); consequently it does not challenge the ordinary-tree target or any registered counterexample fence.

assessment: The core claim is valid after narrowing its negative implication to the exact fact that the cited ordinary-shadow and unweighted-flow results furnish no established control of the extra boundary, and that the supplied toy compression changes one endpoint-sensitive addability count. No stated evidence transports the toy to CB or proves/refutes the primary aggregate.
